name: Rajat Roy aka Ryo Ari
epigraph: The interesting systems are the ones that keep going after you stop watching.
bio: This site is the canonical source of truth for my presence online. I build at the seam between hardware and learning systems, and I care about work that is reproducible, verifiable, and shipped in public rather than described.
now: GSoC 2026 at AOSSIE, building deterministic, cryptographically verifiable LLM training. Incoming MCS, University of Sydney, with the Complex Systems group.
